terms.gloss: a bud, an eye on a plant
evidence: Cic. Sen. 53: ineunte vēre exsistit tamquam ad articulōs sarmentōrum ea, quae gemma dīcitur (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The first sense of the word, a swelling; the jewel takes its name from the bud (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: jam lentō turgent in palmite gemmae
phrases.english: now the buds are swelling on the pliant vine shoot

phrases.latin: sed trūdit gemmās et frondēs explicat omnēs
phrases.english: but it pushes out its buds and unfolds all its leaves

sources: Lewis & Short: gemma
